# bsync golden values

Pins SyncPipe's native WCC surface (`syncpipe.surface.wcc_surface`) to bsync, cell by cell.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `pair.csv` | deterministic input pair (300 samples, 1 Hz; y follows x by 3 samples); regenerated by `make_pair.py` (seed `20261008`) |
| `make_golden.R` | the only thing that needs R: writes the three files below from bsync |
| `golden_cells.csv` | bsync `tidy()` of `wcc(x, y, window_size=30, lag_max=10)`: columns `i`, `tau`, `wcc` |
| `golden_glance_mean_abs_z.csv`, `golden_glance_peak.csv` | bsync `glance()` for the two WCC statistics |
| `VERSIONS.txt` | bsync and R versions that produced them |

Until `golden_cells.csv` exists the conformance test is **skipped** with an explanatory reason; once it is
committed it is a hard gate. Regenerate (and review the diff) whenever bsync's WCC definition changes.
